choices.text: Correct - a streak has to balance out straight away
Wrong - heads is now more likely because it is on a winning run
Wrong - the coin has no memory, so the next toss is still 1/2 tails
Wrong - the next toss cannot be tails after three heads

questions.explanation: The trap is: After three heads, tails is due. A streak feels like it must balance out. Each toss starts fresh: heads and tails stay equally likely, so P(tails) is still 1/2.
questions.misconception: After three heads, tails is due.
questions.prompt: A fair coin has landed heads three times in a row. A classmate says tails must be more likely next because it is overdue. Which statement is correct?
